secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs Better Auth sessions and encrypts stored OAuth tokens. A development placeholder is generated so the app boots without the low-entropy warning; replace it with `openssl rand -base64 32` for any real deployment (changing it invalidates existing sessions).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID (web application). Add the callback URL shown on the Integrations card.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Same Google OAuth client as GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Entra (Azure AD) → App registrations → your app → Application (client) ID.

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Entra app registration → Certificates & secrets → client secret value.

secrets.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → Client ID.

secrets.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Same GitHub OAuth App → generate a client secret.
